{{Top|leg}}
A '''proton-shield''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. It was part of the defensive systems used on [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms']] [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] [[Anti-Infantry Turret|anti-infantry battery]]. The shield was generated by a [[proton shield generator]] from projectors located at the base of the tower and on the edge of the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turret.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
